notes: Top-level summary: Aurum builds regulatory-aware insights for small banks; heavy emphasis on deterministic retrieval and audit trails. Primary driver here = reduce token cost for query pipelines while keeping <120ms 95th pct tail for short queries (single-chunk); acceptable batch latency up to 350ms for rerank flows. Current stack uses Pinecone (managed) + in-house pgvector for cold store. Looking for: 1) connector that supports hybrid search (ANN + metadata filters) with consistent per-tenant namespaces; 2) bulk async upsert (50k+/min) and backpressure signals; 3) multi-region replication + per-region residency controls; 4) per-item TTL and versioned metadata for audit/replay; 5) support for embedding dims 1536 and quantized indexes (8-bit) to control cost.

requirements_summary: Indexing scale target: 10M-50M vectors (initial 10M). QPS targets: 200 sustained search QPS across multi-tenant workload; reranking step for top-50 candidates with per-request cost target < $0.015/query. Latency SLA desired: p95 < 200ms for 1-2 chunk queries, p95 < 400ms for rerank pipeline. Connector must support zero-downtime reindexing, namespace isolation per customer, metadata boolean + numeric filters, stored vectors + payload size up to 8KB, snapshot/restore for disaster recovery, and instrumentation (per-query token + cost breakdown).
technical_preferences: Preferred vector DBs to integrate: Pinecone (already in POC), Weaviate (open schema), pgvector (for owned cold store). Elastic could be fallback for unified logs. They want connector SDK (python + go) with async bulk upsert, backpressure, observable metrics (ingest lag, index fragmentation, query tail latencies), and compatibility with Redwood's prefix-KV caching and batching model.
poe_comments: Customer quote from 2/12: 'We need to avoid surprise costs — bulk reranks are the killer if each token-op costs us 5x.' — Decision maker: Head of Data Products (Marta Colón).
proposal_feedback: Finance asked for a line-item showing Dedicated vs hosted; prefer 12-month committed capacity with burst credits. Security asked for SOC2 + HSM assurance for KMS. Engineering asked for proof of ability to run rerank locally with cached intents to reduce token counts.
poc_scope: Phase 1: 2-week dedicated eval on Redwood Dedicated (1 node pool) ingest 1M vectors from 3 tenants, run mixed QPS profile, measure p50/p95 latency and token cost per query. Phase 2: scale to 10M vectors and run 72h endurance. Phase 3: integrate Weaviate connector + test cross-region replication. Acceptance: p95 latency targets met and infra run rate under forecasted ARR cost per query.

- SOC2 + SSO pass in security review
